purpose: Document first-party Spanish cadastral context, local municipal parcel-map evidence, and bounded anonymous geometry access.
assessment: The Spanish Directorate-General for the Cadastre provides the national public cadastral map/WMS. The official Las Palmas de Gran Canaria municipal ArcGIS REST service exposes a local parcel cartography layer (PARCELA_ar) with polygon geometry and safe objectid/globalid fields. The exact WUP point did not intersect a returned municipal polygon; a bounded approximately 2 km envelope query returned two polygons. This is evidence of a public local parcel-map service and bounded geometry access, not citywide completeness or exact-point absence.
registryAssessment: A local first-party municipal parcel/cartography map is evidenced by the Ayuntamiento-linked SIT Las Palmas ArcGIS service. The Spanish national cadastral custodian is the Dirección General del Catastro; the municipal layer is not treated as a substitute for official cadastral ownership or title records.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Sede Electrónica del Catastro describes the public property search and cartographic viewer.

Official Catastro WMS documentation identifies the public national cadastral map service, its Spain-wide scope excluding the foral systems, supported CRS including EPSG:4326 and Canary Islands UTM zone 28, and non-mass-download limitation.
Official municipal page lists the municipality's geographic viewers.

First-party municipal SIT ArcGIS MapServer named geursa/Parcela; service metadata describes Cartografía base/Carto PGO Las Palmas G.C., EPSG:3857 display extent, GeoJSON query support, and parcel sublayers PARCELA_ln and PARCELA_ar.

Layer metadata identifies PARCELA_ar as polygon geometry sourced in EPSG:32628 and exposes safe fields objectid (OID) and globalid (GlobalID), plus geometry. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, or account fields were requested or retained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No feature returned for the exact WUP point query; this is not treated as citywide absence or a definitive parcel miss.
requestEvidence: Layer metadata GET returned HTTP 200 and confirmed polygon geometry, source EPSG:32628, and safe objectid/globalid fields.
Exact-point anonymous query using the WUP coordinate transformed to EPSG:3857, returnGeometry=true, outFields=objectid,globalid, returned HTTP 200 with zero features.

Bounded anonymous envelope query approximately 2 km wide around the WUP point, resultRecordCount=3, orderByFields=objectid, outFields=objectid,globalid, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, f=geojson returned HTTP 200 with two polygon features; only two were retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal SIT parcel/cartography layer for Las Palmas de Gran Canaria; national Catastro WMS documentation describes Spain-wide cadastral map scope.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous access to the municipal PARCELA_ar layer metadata and a bounded geometry query was verified. Exact-point inclusion and citywide completeness were not verified.

attempts.result: Anonymous service metadata returned; local municipal parcel/cartography service and PARCELA_ar sublayer were identified.
Anonymous layer metadata returned polygon geometry, source EPSG:32628, and fields objectid/globalid; no unsafe fields were requested for retention.
Exact WUP-point query returned an empty FeatureCollection. This bounded result is not evidence of citywide absence.
Bounded approximately 2 km envelope returned two polygon features; two safe-ID polygons were retained after removing all source-specific properties except canonical globalid.

Attempted official national Catastro WMS capabilities request; the direct curl attempt returned HTTP 400 in this environment. Official WMS documentation was retained as scope and CRS evidence; no geometry was inferred from the failed capabilities request.

remainingUncertainty: The municipal layer's relationship to the current authoritative national cadastral parcel database, exact WUP-point parcel inclusion, update date, and citywide feature completeness remain uncertain. No owner/address/titleholder or other unsafe data was requested.
